messages.author: 64e8a55751780494
messages.subject: Extremely difficult installation procedure - constant crashing on loading
parts:
I am running Windows XP SP3. I have spent the last 4 days trying to
get a proper installation of this program without success.

I follow the instructions as per http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Internet_Connected.html


> library(rattle)
Rattle: Graphical interface for data mining using R.
Version 2.5.47 Copyright (c) 2006-2010 Togaware Pty Ltd.
Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
> rattle()
Error in inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...) :
unable to load shared object 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-212~1.0/library/RGtk2/
libs/i386/RGtk2.dll':
LoadLibrary failure: The specified procedure could not be found.


Failed to load RGtk2 dynamic library, attempting to install it.
trying URL 'http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gtk-win/gtk2-
runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe?download'
Content type 'application/x-msdos-program' length 7820679 bytes (7.5
Mb)
opened URL
downloaded 7.5 Mb

Learn more about GTK+ at http://www.gtk.org
If the package still does not load, please ensure that GTK+ is
installed and that it is on your PATH environment variable
IN ANY CASE, RESTART R BEFORE TRYING TO LOAD THE PACKAGE AGAIN
Error in as.GType(type) : Cannot convert RGtkBuilder to GType
>


I havve installed, completly uninstalled, removed *.rdata file (which
was crashing the system onload)

I have 1 day before my university course ends lectures on this subject
and i have not completed a single lab exercise.

I am at a loss of what to do.


I restart, i uninstall GTK+, i reinstall, then crashes...

AppName: rgui.exe AppVer: 2.120.53317.0 ModName: msvcrt.dll
ModVer: 7.0.2600.5512 Offset: 00037fd4


When I restart R, and type in

library(rattle)

then

Rattle()

I get a popup, "the procedure entry point deflateSetHeader could not
be located in the dynamic link library zlib1.dll

continually doing this, I RESTART as instructed etc etc.

messages.author: 64e8a55751780494
messages.subject: Re: Extremely difficult installation procedure - constant crashing on loading
parts:
Ok, I have overcome the above issue. What an effort...4 days and 4
hours.

this is how i achieved this.

Restarted and got same error.

I closed R, (Said NO to saving workspace)

Then I installed gtk-2.12.9-win32-2.exe again
Then I installed gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe

Restarted R and it worked, requested some instalaltion of other
packages alike colourspace and cairo, installed these as required.

The main issue I believe that everyone is having is that they nistall
as per instructions, and for some reason after starting R, a request
is given to add the libraries and then it updated gtk and/or gtk+
within R, this causes the issue of related to not installaing the
aforementioned packages BEFORE R.


MY RECOMMENDATION IS......use UBUNTU install, it is easier and
faster!.
